function.name: bash
function.description: Run a bash command in your Linux workspace container. The shell session PERSISTS across calls (cwd, env vars, background jobs); it resets if a command times out, floods output, or the workspace sat idle for ~10 minutes — files in /work always survive, so do not rely on env vars or cwd across long gaps. No network access. User uploads are in /work/attachments/. Python 3 with Pillow and NumPy, ImageMagick, rsvg-convert for SVG, pdftotext, jq, file, and rg are installed. Use it to inspect uploaded files, compute geometry, analyze mc.dump exports, or generate data files for builds to read with mc.readFile.

command.description: The bash command to run. For python, always use a real multi-line heredoc: python3 - <<'EOF' (newline) code (newline) EOF — never cram code into python3 -c with \n escapes. Avoid interactive commands.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum run time in milliseconds (default 10000, max 120000).
